name: Hikikomori Hime o Mukae Ni
original_name: ひきこもり姫を迎えに
source:
The hero, Kazu, is visiting the Shut-In Princess's tower again today.
He wants to ask for forgiveness and bring back her smile...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/13808]Freem![/url]]
translation:
勇者卡茲今天也來到了家裡蹲公主的高塔前。
他想要請求原諒，讓她重新展露笑容……

[譯自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/13808]Freem![/url]]
